method.name: HasIntegers
method.description: Returns true if at least one named integer value is kept in the attribute.

method.name: HasReals
method.description: Returns true if at least one named real value is kept in the attribute.

method.name: HasStrings
method.description: Returns true if there are some named strings in the attribute.

method.name: HasBytes
method.description: Returns true if there are some named bytes in the attribute.

method.name: HasArraysOfIntegers
method.description: Returns true if there are some named arrays of integer values in the attribute.

method.name: HasArraysOfReals
method.description: Returns true if there are some named arrays of real values in the attribute.

method.name: HasDeferredData
method.description: Returns TRUE if some data is not loaded from deferred storage and can be loaded using LoadDeferredData().

method.name: LoadDeferredData
method.description: Load data from deferred storage, without calling Backup(). As result, the content of the object will be overridden by data from deferred storage (which is normally read-only).

method.name: UnloadDeferredData
method.description: Releases data if object has connected deferred storage, without calling Backup(). WARNING! This operation does not unload modifications to deferred storage (normally it is read-only), so that modifications will be discarded (if any).

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: GetID
method.description: Returns the ID of the named data attribute.

method.name: Set
method.description: Finds or creates a named data attribute.
